description: Source code for generating TypeScript type definitions for Playwright, including classes, methods, and documentation parsing.

classes.name: TypesGenerator
classes.description: Class responsible for generating TypeScript type definitions from documentation and code analysis.

methods.name: generateTypes
methods.description: Generates TypeScript type definitions based on documentation and overrides.

methods.name: canIgnoreMissingName
methods.description: Determines if a missing class or method can be ignored based on ignore list.

methods.name: shouldGenerate
methods.description: Checks if a class or method should be generated based on do-not-generate list.

methods.name: docClassForName
methods.description: Retrieves documentation class info for a given class name.

methods.name: objectDefinitionsToString
methods.description: Converts object definitions to TypeScript interface strings.

methods.name: nameForProperty
methods.description: Determines property name, adding '?' if optional.

methods.name: classToString
methods.description: Converts a class description to a TypeScript interface string.

methods.name: argNameForType
methods.description: Generates argument name based on type.

methods.name: hasUniqueEvents
methods.description: Checks if a class has events not inherited from parent.

methods.name: classBody
methods.description: Generates the body of a class/interface including methods and events.

methods.name: hasOwnMethod
methods.description: Checks if a class has its own method implementation.

methods.name: parentClass
methods.description: Retrieves parent class of a given class.

methods.name: writeComment
methods.description: Formats comments with proper indentation and links.

methods.name: stringifyComplexType
methods.description: Converts complex type objects to string representations.

methods.name: stringifyObjectType
methods.description: Converts object property lists to string.

methods.name: stringifySimpleType
methods.description: Converts simple type objects to string.

methods.name: argsFromMember
methods.description: Generates argument string from member args.

methods.name: memberJSDOC
methods.description: Generates JSDoc comments for class members.
